instruction: Enable the compact sliders option in GIMP.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling compact sliders in GIMP preferences. The evaluator checks the gimprc configuration file for the compact-sliders parameter with value yes. Uses existing check_config_status metric and gimp_config_file getter.
